title: Amazon's plan to own the world's product data and fight AI shopping agents
summary: Called World Product Graph, the initiative seeks to hoover up data on virtually every item for sale on Earth, whether Amazon stocks it or not, according to an internal document reviewed by Reuters, and to people familiar with the matter.
llm_summary: Amazon is building a “World Product Graph,” a massive database that aims to catalog virtually every item for sale anywhere on the planet—whether or not Amazon actually stocks it. By aggregating this exhaustive product data, the company hopes to power its own AI‑driven shopping assistants and stay ahead of third‑party AI agents that could otherwise guide consumers to rival retailers.
